description: Edit or inspect one position. Omit every optional field to inspect.

pane_id.description: The pane holding the drawing; a drawing id is unique only within it.

ratio.description:
Reward per unit of risk, 0.1 through 20, as a canonical decimal:
`"2"` is risk 1 : reward 2. Only the target moves.

tab_id.description: The tab holding the drawing, as `analysis.drawings` lists it.

width_bars.description:
Drawn width in bars, 14 through 100000. The right-hand anchor moves
in market time at the anchors' own pace; the left edge and every price
hold. Refused when the anchors share a bar or carry no market time.

zone_opacity_pct.description: Both zones' fill opacity, 0 through 100 percent.

title: PositionSetInput
